propositions: Cumulative counter streams in observability.sh advance their offset file before CloudWatch accepts the put-metric-data call, causing transient AWS failures to permanently lose the failed interval's count
A failed metric publication followed by retry computes zero delta instead of the accumulated total because the offset was already advanced during the failed attempt

Seven affected metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral helper, shared interrupt helper, G2P) share the same defective offset-before-publish pattern
The fix reorders each stream to advance the offset only after successful AWS publication, leaving the offset byte-identical on failure for retry on the next run
Regression testing verifies that forced CloudWatch failures preserve the offset unchanged and that subsequent successful runs publish the accumulated delta before advancing the offset
